name: fx_version
description: Required. Version of the manifest format. Each version includes the behaviour of the previous ones. `adamant` requires a `game` entry and is the minimum for RedM; `bodacious` implies `clr_disable_task_scheduler`; `cerulean` loads NUI pages in a secure context (NUI callbacks use https://). Use `cerulean`.

name: game
description: Required with every fx_version. Game(s) supported by the resource: `gta5` for FiveM, `rdr3` for RedM (also requires `rdr3_warning`), `common` for any game using only Cfx APIs. Use the plural form `games { ... }` to list several. (LibertyM uses `gta4`.)

name: rdr3_warning
values: I acknowledge that this is a prerelease build of RedM, and I am aware my resources *will* become incompatible once RedM ships.
description: Required for resources running on RedM. The value must be exactly this sentence, otherwise the server refuses to start the resource.
example: rdr3_warning 'I acknowledge that this is a prerelease build of RedM, and I am aware my resources *will* become incompatible once RedM ships.'

name: resource_manifest_version
description: Legacy manifest version GUID used in `__resource.lua`. Replaced by `fxmanifest.lua` with `fx_version`.

name: author
description: Free-form metadata: the resource's author. Readable with `GetResourceMetadata`.

name: description
description: Free-form metadata: a short description of the resource.

name: version
description: Free-form metadata: the resource's version.

name: client_script
description: Script(s) loaded on each client, in order, after the shared scripts. Supports globbing (`client/*.lua`, `**/cl_*.lua`) and `@resource/path` to include a file of another resource. The extension selects the runtime: `.lua`, `.js`, `.net.dll`.

name: server_script
description: Script(s) loaded on the server, in order, after the shared scripts. Supports globbing and `@resource/path`.

name: shared_script
description: Script(s) loaded on both the client and the server, before the side-specific scripts. Supports globbing and `@resource/path`.

name: file
description: File(s) downloaded by clients without being executed: NUI pages and assets, data files, JSON read with `LoadResourceFile`. Client and shared scripts are included automatically.

name: export
description: Name(s) of global functions of the client scripts to export to other resources. Prefer `exports('name', fn)` in the script.

name: server_export
description: Name(s) of global functions of the server scripts to export to other resources. Prefer `exports('name', fn)` in the script.

name: ui_page
description: The resource's NUI page: a file of the resource (also listed in `files`) or an absolute https:// URL.

name: ui_page_preload
description: When present, the NUI frame is created as soon as the resource starts instead of only being prepared.

name: nui_callback_strict_mode
description: With the value 'true' (and a single ui_page), NUI callbacks of this resource only accept requests from its own page.

name: loadscreen
description: HTML file used as the game loading screen. List it (and its assets) in `files` too.

name: loadscreen_manual_shutdown
description: Keeps the loading screen open after the game has loaded, until a script calls `ShutdownLoadingScreenNui()`.

name: loadscreen_cursor
description: Shows the mouse cursor on the loading screen (it is hidden by default).

name: data_file
description: Registers a game data file of the given type: `data_file 'TYPE' 'path'`. The path supports globbing and must also be listed in `files`. The values are the GTA V data file types listed in the data files reference.

name: this_is_a_map
description: Marks the resource as a map: map storage is reloaded when it loads. Any value works.

name: server_only
description: Marks the resource as server-only: clients download nothing from it. Any value works.

name: replace_level_meta
description: Replaces the level meta with the given file of the resource (name without the .meta extension). The file must be listed in `files`.

name: before_level_meta
description: Loads the given level meta before the primary one. Use data files instead.

name: after_level_meta
description: Loads the given level meta after the primary one. Use data files instead.

name: dependency
description: A resource that must be started before this one, or a runtime constraint starting with '/': '/server:<build>', '/policy:<name>', '/onesync', '/gameBuild:<build>', '/native:<hash>'. The table form is spelled `dependencies`.

name: dependencies
description: Table form of `dependency`: resources that must be started first, and runtime constraints ('/server:4500', '/policy:subdir_file_mapping', '/onesync', '/gameBuild:h4', '/native:0xE27C97A0').

name: provide
description: Declares that this resource replaces another one: it starts when the other is required and acts as it.

name: lua54
description: No effect: all Lua scripts run on Lua 5.4 since Lua 5.3 support was removed in June 2025. Can be removed.

name: use_experimental_fxv2_oal
description: Experimental: faster native calls for Lua with corrected return types (BOOL out-values become booleans). Disables vector unrolling in native arguments and can break natives whose documented types are wrong.

name: node_version
description: Node.js version used by the resource's server-side JavaScript. Default: 16.

name: clr_disable_task_scheduler
description: Disables the custom C# task scheduler on the server. Implied by fx_version `bodacious` and later.

name: escrow_ignore
description: Files that Asset Escrow must leave unencrypted, such as configuration files.

name: convar_category
description: Adds convars of this resource to FxDK's Project Settings page: `convar_category 'Name' { title, { { label, convar, type, default, ... } } }`. Types: CV_STRING, CV_BOOL, CV_INT, CV_SLIDER, CV_COMBI, CV_PASSWORD, CV_MULTI. Prefix replicated convars with '$' and server-info convars with '#'.
